release_notes:
🚀 What's New in v1.5.0:

🎨 App Identity Redesign & Improvements:
- New app icon, logo, and animated launch screen for a polished first impression.
- Fully redesigned settings page with a new layout and visual system.
- Custom icons are being rolled out across the app in upcoming updates.

⚡ Quick Play:
- Automatically picks the best server for faster, smoother playback.
- Manual server selection is still available whenever you want full control.

🖥️ Redesigned Content Screens:
- Details screen rebuilt from the ground up with manga download support.
- Explore screen redesigned and anime screen updated for the new details layout.
- Source selection screen now supports landscape mode.

📚 Manga Mode Dock:
- Redesigned dock with a dedicated manga mode entry point.

▶️ Instant Continue Watching:
- Tapping Continue Watching now opens the player directly to resume — no extra stop at the details screen.

🛠 Technical Fixes:
- Fixed incorrect season matching in anime search; improved overall match accuracy.
- Fixed internet connectivity issue affecting content loading.
- New setting under Anime & Sources to control parallel source search count — reduces lag on older devices.
